definitions.total_ip_ranges: Tag-prefix memberships: the same CIDR listed under two tags counts twice.
definitions.added_memberships: Prefixes that joined a tag (including every prefix of a new tag).
definitions.removed_memberships: Prefixes that left a tag (including every prefix of a removed tag).
definitions.coverage: Address space newly covered / no longer covered, computed per tag and summed across tags (IPv4 in addresses, IPv6 in /64 networks).
definitions.classification: expansion: only new address space; contraction: only lost address space; mixed: both; representation_only: CIDRs changed but covered addresses are identical.
